Apply N38b-04's due filter in the same-run rule: a listed control whose `due` is later than the part being recorded is not required in the receipt (it is reported `not-yet-due`); a part whose listed controls are all not yet due has no control and records nothing (`pass-without-control`). Otherwise the M0 part of GATE-WS-07 (controls X41-07 due M2, X41-08 due M3) can never be recorded.

Apply N38b-04's due filter in the registry check: rule 3's `uncaught-control` and the no-control check skip a listed control whose `due` is later than the part in question, and a part whose controls are all not yet due is `not-eligible`.
